levels.surface: جعفر بن محمد بن مسعود العياشي

notes: «15 - نَصٌّ آخَرُ» is a number and a label: left out.
«قُلْتُ: وَكَيْفَ ذلِكَ؟» is an unnamed questioner inside the saying. The asker is not a reason to rule (rule 11), and he is not a link.
Muhammad ibn Yazid is the last link: the saying is his («أنه قال»). Blessings after the names are left out.
